title: Brownies
incredients: Dark chocolate, butter, sugar, eggs, flour, and cocoa powder.
recipe: Preheat the oven and line a baking tray.Melt chocolate and butter together.Mix sugar and eggs into the chocolate mixture.Fold in flour and cocoa powder.Pour batter into the tray.Bake until set but slightly fudgy.

title: Chocolate Cake
desc: Where every bite melts your worries away
incredients: Flour, cocoa powder, sugar, eggs, butter, baking powder, and milk.
recipe: Preheat the oven and grease a cake pan.Mix flour, cocoa powder, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl.Add eggs, melted butter, and milk, then whisk into a smooth batter.Pour the batter into the pan.Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.Cool and frost with chocolate icing.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
incredients: Milk, cream, sugar, vanilla essence, and cornflour.
recipe: Heat milk and cream with sugar until dissolved.Add vanilla essence and mix well.Let the mixture cool completely.Pour into a container and freeze.Stir every 1–2 hours until creamy.Freeze until firm and serve.

title: Cheesecake
desc: Creamy luxury on a crumbly base
incredients: Cream cheese, biscuits, butter, sugar, eggs, and vanilla.
recipe: Crush biscuits and mix with melted butter.Press the mixture into a cake tin and chill.Beat cream cheese, sugar, eggs, and vanilla.Pour filling over the base.Bake on low heat until set.Chill before slicing.

title: Donuts
incredients: Flour, yeast, sugar, milk, eggs, butter, and oil.
recipe: Prepare dough using flour, yeast, sugar, milk, and butter.Let the dough rise until doubled.Roll and cut donut shapes.Fry in hot oil until golden.Drain excess oil.Coat with sugar or glaze.

title: Cupcakes
incredients: Flour, sugar, butter, eggs, baking powder, and milk.
recipe: Preheat oven and line cupcake tray.Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.Add eggs and mix well.Fold in flour and milk.Fill cupcake liners halfway.Bake and cool before frosting.

title: Apple Pie
incredients: Apples, flour, butter, sugar, cinnamon, and lemon juice.
recipe: Peel and slice apples.Mix apples with sugar, cinnamon, and lemon juice.Prepare pie dough and line the pan.Add apple filling.Cover with top crust.Bake until golden brown.

title: Gulab Jamun
incredients: Milk powder, flour, sugar, cardamom, ghee, and water.
recipe: Prepare soft dough using milk powder and flour.Shape into small smooth balls.Fry on low heat until golden.Prepare sugar syrup with cardamom.Add fried balls to warm syrup.Let them soak before serving.

title: Rasgulla
incredients: Milk, lemon juice, sugar, and water.
recipe: Boil milk and curdle with lemon juice.Strain and knead chenna until smooth.Shape into small balls.Boil sugar and water to make syrup.Add balls and cook until spongy.Cool and serve chilled.

title: Tiramisu
incredients: Ladyfinger biscuits, coffee, mascarpone cheese, eggs, sugar, and cocoa powder.
recipe: Brew strong coffee and let it cool.Dip ladyfinger biscuits briefly in coffee.Beat mascarpone, sugar, and eggs.Layer biscuits and cream mixture.Repeat layers.Dust cocoa powder and chill.

title: Pudding
incredients: Milk, sugar, cornflour, vanilla, and butter.
recipe: Mix milk, sugar, and cornflour in a pan.Cook on low heat while stirring.Add vanilla essence.Cook until thick.Pour into bowls.Chill before serving.

title: Pancakes
incredients: Flour, eggs, milk, sugar, baking powder, and butter.
recipe: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, milk, and eggs.Heat a pan and grease lightly.Pour batter onto pan.Cook until bubbles appear.Flip and cook other side.Serve with syrup.

title: Waffles
incredients: Flour, eggs, milk, sugar, butter, and baking powder.
recipe: Prepare batter using flour, eggs, milk, and butter.Preheat waffle maker.Pour batter into the mold.Close lid and cook until golden.Remove carefully.Serve with toppings.

title: Churros
incredients: Flour, water, butter, sugar, and oil.
recipe: Boil water, butter, and sugar. Add flour and mix into dough.Transfer dough to piping bag.Pipe into hot oil.Fry until crispy.Roll in sugar and serve.

title: Ice Cream Sundae
incredients: Ice cream, chocolate syrup, nuts, fruits, and whipped cream.
recipe: Place ice cream scoops in a bowl. Drizzle chocolate or caramel sauce. Add nuts and fruits. Top with whipped cream. Add cherry if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Custard
incredients: Milk, custard powder, sugar, and vanilla.
recipe: Mix custard powder with cold milk. Heat remaining milk with sugar. Add custard mixture slowly. Stir continuously to avoid lumps. Cook until thick. Cool and serve

title: Mousse
desc: Light as air, rich in flavor
incredients: Chocolate, cream, sugar, and eggs.
recipe: Melt chocolate and let it cool.Whip cream until soft peaks form.Fold melted chocolate gently.Add sugar if needed.Pour into bowls.Chill until set.

title: Carrot Cake
incredients: Carrots, flour, sugar, eggs, oil, and cinnamon.
recipe: Preheat oven and grease pan.Mix flour, sugar, and cinnamon.Add eggs, oil, and grated carrots.Mix into smooth batter.Pour into pan.Bake until cooked through.

title: Panna Cotta
incredients: Cream, milk, sugar, gelatin, and vanilla.
recipe: Heat cream, milk, and sugar gently. Dissolve gelatin separately. Add gelatin to warm cream mixture. Add vanilla essence. Pour into molds. Chill until set.

title: Halwa
desc: Traditional sweetness with a warm heart
incredients: Semolina, ghee, sugar, water, and nuts.
recipe: Heat ghee in a pan. Roast semolina until aromatic. Prepare sugar syrup separately. Add syrup to semolina slowly. Stir continuously. Garnish with nuts and serve.

title: Milkshake
incredients: Milk, ice cream(Add your flavour), sugar, and flavoring.
recipe: Add milk, ice cream(Add your flavour), and sugar to blender. Add chosen flavor or fruit. Blend until smooth. Adjust thickness if needed. Pour into glasses. Serve chilled.

title: Éclairs
incredients: Flour, eggs, butter, cream, sugar, and chocolate.
recipe: Prepare choux pastry dough. Pipe onto baking tray. Bake until puffed and golden. Let cool and slice. Fill with cream. Top with chocolate glaze.

title: Lamington
incredients: Sponge cake, chocolate sauce, and coconut.
recipe: Cut sponge cake into cubes. Prepare chocolate sauce. Dip cake pieces into sauce. Roll in coconut. Place on tray to set. Serve once firm.

title: Crème Brûlée
incredients: Cream, egg yolks, sugar, and vanilla.
recipe: Heat cream with vanilla. Whisk egg yolks and sugar. Combine cream with eggs gently. Pour into ramekins. Bake in water bath.Caramelize sugar on top before serving.

title: Banoffee Pie
incredients: Bananas, biscuits, butter, cream, and caramel.
recipe: Crush biscuits and mix with butter. Press into pie base and chill. Spread caramel layer. Add sliced bananas. Top with whipped cream. Chill and serve.
